identity.title: Hermes Draft Prompt Contract Alignment And Schema Diagnostics
identity.objective: H1 #3 (the third real S10-GATE-H1 invocation) completed a real controlled research/model interaction from the runtime/usage perspective but failed terminal OUTPUT_SCHEMA_INVALID / DRAFT_FIELD_MISSING. Forensics: the persisted session had correct schema_version and request_id but all other canonical required fields absent, an alternative schema improvised (first missing canonical field advisory_only), web_search/web_extract observed, no unexpected tools. Root cause: the permanent instruction referenced a 'provided research-draft schema' the envelope never embedded (only draft_schema_version). WP175M fixes the contract BEFORE generation: models.py owns a canonical machine-generated draft output schema derived from the SAME constants validate_research_draft enforces (STOP CONTRACT_VALIDATOR_DRIFT); the private list-field collection becomes public DRAFT_LIST_FIELDS plus a canonical ordered DRAFT_REQUIRED_TOP_LEVEL_FIELDS; build_research_draft_output_schema embeds every required field, authority const=true flags, confidence/source-class enums, validator-aligned bounds, and the exact request id and draft schema version as constants; the instruction is bumped to 1.1.0 and the envelope carries an authoritative draft_output_schema. NO post-hoc substantive repair and NO wrapper-owned authority-flag injection: a wrong schema still fails closed. Sanitized diagnostics (inspect_research_draft_structure) retain ONLY static canonical field-name tokens and fixed statuses. The receipt is bumped to hermes-research-run-receipt/1.3.0 with additive prompt_envelope_sha256, draft_output_contract_sha256, draft diagnostics, and usage_session_id_digest. With valid usage the actual provider/model are preserved before draft validation without changing failure precedence. Request/policy identity, Hermes pin, and the frozen H1 request id are unchanged. WP175M does not run Hermes, authorize H1 #4, or unlock Alpha.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert WP175M. The public draft-contract constants (DRAFT_LIST_FIELDS, DRAFT_REQUIRED_TOP_LEVEL_FIELDS, the validator-aligned bound constants, the sorted enums, diagnostic status constants), build_research_draft_output_schema, inspect_research_draft_structure, DraftStructureDiagnostics, the receipt 1.3.0 additive fields, the envelope draft_output_schema field and its digest, the system-instruction 1.1.0 bump, the controller evidence preservation and diagnostics wiring, their focused tests, the WP175M package records, and narrow current-truth updates are removed. No provider, Firecrawl, OAuth, order, Gate-C, Alpha, or live state exists to unwind; the frozen H1 request id and policy identity are unchanged by this WP.

api_matrix.reason: WP175M aligns the prompt output contract with the validator, adds sanitized structural diagnostics, and adds additive receipt evidence; it adds no research authority and no provider/Firecrawl/OAuth surface.

items.before: The draft field contract lived only inside validate_research_draft, and _DRAFT_LIST_FIELDS was private; the prompt referenced a 'provided research-draft schema' that was never actually embedded (only draft_schema_version was supplied).
items.after: A public canonical ordered required-field set, a public list-field collection, validator-aligned bound constants, and a deterministic build_research_draft_output_schema that derives every constraint (required set, authority const=true flags, confidence/source-class enums, bounds, exact request id and draft schema version constants) from the SAME constants the validator enforces.
items.compatibility_requirement: The generated schema required set is identical to the validator required set; identical inputs yield byte-identical canonical serialization; no constraint the validator does not enforce is invented.

items.before: A schema failure collapsed to DRAFT_FIELD_MISSING with no safe field-level evidence.
items.after: A sanitized inspector partitions the untrusted document into present/missing canonical required field NAMES (never values) with a first-missing field and a fixed status (AVAILABLE / UNAVAILABLE_INVALID_OUTPUT); only static canonical tokens are ever retained.
items.compatibility_requirement: Output consists solely of predefined canonical field-name tokens and fixed statuses; no rejected value, arbitrary model key, URL, or research text is emitted.

items.before: The envelope carried only draft_schema_version and the instruction claimed a schema was 'provided'.
items.after: The envelope carries the authoritative machine-generated draft_output_schema in as_mapping/to_query_bytes/to_prompt_string/envelope_digest and a draft_output_contract_digest property; the instruction (version 1.1.0) states the schema is authoritative, requires exact field names, forbids alias substitution, and requires real (never fabricated) substantive research.
items.compatibility_requirement: Request identity and policy identity are unchanged (the schema lives in the envelope, not the request or policy identity_fields); the frozen H1 request id still derives from public_fields().

items.before: Receipt schema 1.2.0; a schema failure recorded verified_provider/model as null because binding ran after validation; no prompt/contract digest or session-id digest existed.
items.after: Receipt schema 1.3.0 adds prompt_envelope_sha256, draft_output_contract_sha256, draft_diagnostics_status, draft_present_required_fields, draft_missing_required_fields, draft_first_missing_field, and usage_session_id_digest, all in the content-addressed identity; with valid usage the controller preserves the actual provider/model before draft validation and records the sanitized session-id digest; the provider/model mismatch terminal gate still runs after draft validation.
items.compatibility_requirement: Deterministic fail-closed defaults for pre-research/no-draft paths (None digests, NOT_REACHED diagnostics); raw session id is never retained; historical 1.2.0 receipts remain valid and are not rewritten.

semantic_fields.reason: The generated output contract, the sanitized diagnostics, and the additive receipt evidence must be provably aligned with the validator and must never broaden authority or retain rejected content.
